verdicts.reason: A keeps the Solstice logo and has a readable left-to-right flow. But the missing-asset placeholder collides with the can and the 'Saturday 21 June' line, the RSVP CTA is shrunk into the chip row so it is buried, and the legal text on the right is as big as the event details. B loses the logo (only a stray sun is left) and puts 'Solstice Presents' under the headline instead of above it. The RSVP pill is cropped at the top edge, the chips are split up (Tastings sits apart from Free Entry and All Ages, and those two are cut off at the bottom), and the date and legal text are tiny. B is unusable.
